Single academic figure (figsize 7.2x4.5 inches, 300 DPI). Clean, minimal, balanced. This figure explains how CED (Contrastive Evidence Discrimination) scoring works.

ABSOLUTELY NO TITLE, NO HEADER at the top. The paper caption handles the title.

Style MUST match the companion Figure 1 (overview figure) exactly: same rounded rectangle style, same font feel, same color palette, same shadow style, same arrow style. This is the SAME paper — visual consistency is critical.

=== LAYOUT ===

Three vertical zones: Top strip (~20% height) for context, Middle area (~50% height) for the two NLI pairs side-by-side, Bottom strip (~30% height) for NLI model + CED score.

=== TOP STRIP: Context ===

A rounded rectangle (corner radius 8px), facecolor #FAFAFA, thin solid border #CCCCCC (1pt), subtle drop shadow (1.5px, 6% opacity).

Inside, two lines of text:
Line 1 (9pt bold, #333333): "Document:"
Line 2 (8.5pt serif, #444444): "[S1] John was born in London.  [S2] He studied at Oxford.  [S3] London is in England."
Entity names colored inline as bold text:
  "John" in #0072B2 bold
  "London" in #009E73 bold
  "Oxford" in #E69F00 bold

Below the document box, a small line (8.5pt, #333333):
"Triple: (John, place_of_birth, London)" — with "John" in #0072B2 bold and "London" in #009E73 bold.

=== MIDDLE AREA: Two NLI Pairs Side-by-Side ===

LEFT (~48% width) — Positive Pair:
Rounded rectangle (corner radius 8px), facecolor #EEF5FB (light blue tint), SOLID border #0072B2 (1.5pt), subtle shadow.
"Positive Pair" label at top inside box, 9pt bold, #0072B2.
Inside (8.5pt):
  "Premise (evidence):" in #888888
  '[S1] "John was born in London"' in #333333
  "Hypothesis:" in #888888
  '"John has place_of_birth with London"' in #333333

RIGHT (~48% width) — Negative Pair:
Rounded rectangle (corner radius 8px), facecolor #FFF0E8 (light warm tint), SOLID border #D55E00 (1.5pt), subtle shadow.
"Negative Pair (Distractor)" label at top inside box, 9pt bold, #D55E00.
Inside (8.5pt):
  "Premise (distractor):" in #888888
  '[S2] "He studied at Oxford"' in #333333
  "Hypothesis:" in #888888
  '"John has place_of_birth with London"' in #333333

~4% spacing between the two cards.

=== BOTTOM AREA: NLI Model + CED Score ===

CENTER — NLI Model box:
Rounded rectangle (corner radius 10px), solid fill #4A90D9 (medium blue, matching Fig 1's LLM box), subtle shadow (2px, 10% opacity).
"NLI Model" centered, 11pt bold, white.
"(DeBERTa-v3)" below, 7pt, white, slightly transparent.

Arrows:
  Positive Pair → NLI Model: solid #0072B2 arrow (1.2pt)
  Negative Pair → NLI Model: solid #D55E00 arrow (1.2pt)

Output labels from NLI Model:
  Left output: "p⁺ = 0.92" in #009E73 bold, 10pt
  Right output: "p⁻ = 0.31" in #D55E00 bold, 10pt

Below NLI Model, separated by a thin dashed gray line (#CCCCCC):

CED Score calculation (centered, 11pt):
"CED = p⁺ − max(p⁻) = 0.92 − 0.31 = 0.61"
The "0.61" in #0072B2 bold, 13pt.

=== STYLE CONSTRAINTS ===
- 300 DPI, pure white background
- NO title, NO panel labels
- Primary accent: #0072B2 (blue) — same as Fig 1
- Positive/evidence: #0072B2 blue + #009E73 green
- Negative/distractor: #D55E00 vermilion
- Entity colors: Okabe-Ito palette matching Fig 1 (John=#0072B2, London=#009E73, Oxford=#E69F00)
- NO matplotlib defaults: no gray background, no gridlines, no tab10 colors
- Subtle shadows only on cards and NLI model box
- All corners rounded (6-10px)
- Arrowheads: small, refined, triangular
- Generous whitespace
- Clean, minimal, sophisticated — matching Fig 1's style exactly
